headline: ULAB student dies, relatives allege wrong treatment at hospital
summary: A ULAB student passed away at a hospital, with family members claiming the death was due to medical malpractice. The incident has sparked concerns regarding patient care standards.
details: A student from the University of Liberal Arts Bangladesh (ULAB) has reportedly died at a hospital. Relatives of the deceased are alleging that the death occurred due to wrong treatment or medical negligence.
The family's accusations highlight concerns about the quality of care provided at the medical facility. Further details regarding the incident are yet to be officially released.

headline: Government working to prevent brain drain, says Education Minister
summary: The Education Minister stated that the government is actively implementing measures to curb the outflow of skilled professionals from the country, emphasizing its commitment to national development.
details: Bangladesh's Education Minister announced that the government is actively engaged in initiatives aimed at preventing brain drain from the country. This statement highlights a key national concern regarding the outflow of skilled professionals.
